messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Hosted API queue depth rising sharply in us-west-2. Paging oncall. Initial alert: queue depth 18k, p95 latency 2.4s -> 12s, p99 > 30s. Possible GPU capacity exhaustion / autoscaler failures.

oncall-alex: on it. AB oncall here. grabbing metrics — anyone seen recent deploys?

maria-sre: no deploys from our side. Looking at scheduler and autoscaler logs now. GPU pool util 99-100% across all thin-provisioned pools. Autoscaler repeatedly returns create errors.

raj-eng: past 4m of autoscaler logs: "createInstance failed: quotaExceeded" then a flood of "timeout waiting for allocation". attaching snippet.

ops-rotation-bot: log snippet pasted by raj-eng:
```
2026-03-15T18:34:12Z autoscaler mgr: request=pool-usw2-gpu-1 count=8 -> error: quotaExceeded: project computeCpuQuota
2026-03-15T18:34:13Z allocator: attempted-provision 4/8 failed
2026-03-15T18:34:15Z scheduler: fallback route attempted -> throttled
```

sophie-platform: confirmed. Provider returned quota errors and 429s back-to-back. Not an internal crash; we're hitting cloud account limits.

oncall-alex: impact? how many customers timed out? which routes?

beth-cs: I just got ping from 2 customers. One is a medium bot customer in EU (region fallback used), another is high-volume analytics customer. Both saw request timeouts. I'll open an incident timeline for CS.

maria-sre: metrics: total inflight requests 22k, queue growth +6k in 10m. Errors 5xx spiking to 3%. p95 jumped from 300ms baseline to 12s, p99 spiked beyond 30s for several routes (generation endpoints).

raj-eng: short-term mitigation proposal: 1) enable model fallback to smaller quantized variants (lower GPU footprint) for non-critical tiers, 2) disable batch accumulation to reduce latency on top of overloaded pools, 3) route lower-tier traffic to regional soft-fallback (cpu-based model) with rate cap.

oncall-alex: do we have an automated knob to flip model fallback per route?

sophie-platform: yes — /api/v1/ops/route_override -> we can push a config to swap model_family to x-small-quant for 'free' tier routes. I'll prepare.

maria-sre: starting with route overrides for anon/free tier to lower model. Executing changes now. Expecting latency to drop for that segment — should free up ~30% GPU headroom.

ops-rotation-bot: change applied by sophie-platform: route_override -> free-tier -> model: x-small-quant.

raj-eng: also kicked off temp scaling to dedicated cold-pool (reserved) via internal override, but provider quota still blocking additional VM creation. We got 2 extra nodes through a soft-reserve we had; they're spinning up (ETA ~2m).

maria-sre: watching. GPU util dropping from 99 to 86% as small-quant routes move off. Queue growth rate reduced. p95 trending down to ~2.1s.

oncall-alex: nice. Any customer-visible errors still?

beth-cs: customers reporting improvement over last 6m for some endpoints. One customer still seeing occasional timeouts on long-gen calls.

raj-eng: digging into autoscaler error stream — there's also a stuck provisioner leader election churn causing duplicated requests and backpressure on quota calls. Rolling restart for provisioner leader process to clear the election loop.

maria-sre: doing the rolling restart for provisioner leader in us-west-2 now. Will coordinate with raj.

ops-rotation-bot: provisioner leader restart completed. Observing reduced create retries.

maria-sre: autoscaler logs now show fewer errors, provider API 200 responses for create. Additional 2 nodes joined the pool. Queue index decreased by ~4k. p95 ~900ms now. p99 ~3.5s (still elevated).

oncall-alex: good progress. Can we throttle non-critical long-run requests to protect latency?

sophie-platform: enabling short-term lenient rate-limiter on long-gen routes via feature-flag -> will reject new very-long prompts from free tier with guidance message.

beth-cs: pushing a customer advisory to affected customers: ETA stable ~30m, include steps to reduce concurrency and retry backoff suggestions.

maria-sre: summary so far: root cause = combined sudden traffic spike plus cloud provider quota exhaustion + provisioner election churn causing retry storm. Immediate mitigations: route_override -> smaller models, restart provisioner leader, temp provision from cold-pool.

raj-eng: follow-ups to prevent recurrence: - ensure autoscaler has a client‑side quota guard to slow request rate when provider returns repeated quotaExceeded - add circuit-breaker around leader election to avoid retry fanout - improve telemetry for queue-to-gpu mapping per-tenant.

oncall-alex: handing off to night oncall (oncall-jordan) in 30m. Will post final status with checklist and any outstanding customer asks.

ops-rotation-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in place, queue trending down. Postmortem required.

beth-cs: CS will continue customer comms. Notifying impacted enterprise contacts and offering priority credits.

maria-sre: leaving a runbook note: if quota errors reappear, escalate to cloud-account team for immediate temporary quota bump; otherwise enable model-fallback automation earlier in the pipeline.

oncall-alex: thanks all. Handoff to oncall-jordan in 30m — jordon (typo), please ack when you take this.

oncall-jordan: ack. taking over. I'll watch for re-growth and ensure the post-incident checklist is started.

ops-rotation-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVE: queue back to normal baseline after 42 minutes. Root cause candidate and mitigations logged. Postmortem assigned to @maria-sre and @sophie-platform.

maria-sre: filing postmortem now, will include timeline, proposed infra fixes, and CS impact notes.

beth-cs: will attach customer tickets to the postmortem.

oncall-jordan: handover note for next shift: monitor provider quota metrics and set an alert for repeated quotaExceeded with threshold >3 failures in 60s.

ops-rotation-bot: incident thread closed by oncall-jordan."
